scenes.say: In the time it takes you to read this, your body made millions of new blood cells.
About two million red blood cells, every single second.
That's over one hundred and seventy billion a day. So where do they all come from?
Deep inside your bones, in the soft red marrow.
And each one has a deadline.
It lives about a hundred and twenty days. Four times longer than a skin cell.
Right now, about twenty five trillion of them are moving through you.
And while you listened, your body made millions more.
